# getProducts — Universal E-Commerce Product Catalog Exporter

> getProducts is a high-performance e-commerce catalog scraper and multi-platform CSV exporter.

## Core Capabilities
- Scrapes product catalogs from Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, Daraz, Zatiq, and Amazon.
- Formats and exports data into ready-to-import CSV files for Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, and Universal Spreadsheets.
- Supports price markup calculations (+% or +fixed amount) and image count limits.
- Supports bulk product tag management and find-and-replace catalog tools.
